### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What it does.** After each step, combines six failure flags over every block and rank into one cause word, then
accepts the step or restores it and redoes it with a smaller time step.
**Switch.** Integrator `max_redo`, default 5. **Moist causes.** Species repair by the limiter (4) and a cell the
saturation adjustment left unadjusted (16).
**Defining equation.** None: a decision rule, listed in @tbl-ch10-redo-code and checked by `redo_check.py`.
:::

The redo machinery itself (how $\Delta t$ is halved, what the driver does with the return value) belongs to
Chapter 7 and is outlined in @sec-ch01-driver. This section covers the two causes moist physics raises and the
parts of the rule that matter to them. A species repair by the conserved limiter that is larger than round-off
(@sec-ch10-borrow, @sec-ch10-fixvapor) sets the limiter mark, cause 4. A cell that the saturation adjustment
(@sec-ch10-satadj) failed to bring to equilibrium is counted by kintera, and a non-zero count after the step is
cause 16. Either one, on any rank, rejects the step everywhere.

The saturation cause is always on when the thermo has a ThermoY; the limiter cause is on with `limiter: true`.
The redo restores `hydro_u`, recomputes `hydro_w`, restores the scalars, drops the gravity-work fixer's count of
the rejected step and decrements the cycle. Aliases: the saturation cause was added by PR #248, the round-off
bound on the limiter cause by #256 ([chengcli/snapy#256](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/issues/256)).

### Derivation

No derivation: the scheme is a decision rule, not a discretization. Its three properties that the rest of the
chapter relies on are checked by `src/snapy_report/ch10/redo_check.py` against a line-for-line port. The six
flags map to the bits 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 in the order floor, clamp, limiter, nan, saturation, vic-solve
(check line `[C1]`). The maximum over ranks of 0/1 flags is the bitwise OR of every rank's cause word, so one
rank's failure is every rank's (`[C2]`, all 4096 two-rank combinations). Past `max_redo`, a step with a moist cause
terminates without restoring; only the VIC solve cause (32) restores the state first (`[C3]`). The provenance of every
`[Cn]` line is [sha: the formulas of snapy@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0, ported line for line; deck: the
check itself; run: `python3 redo_check.py`, numpy, double].

### Numerical method

@fig-ch10-redo-flow shows the decision. The saturation counter is drained once at the start of every step, so
a failure counted by a ThermoY call between steps (a diagnostic from Python, say) is not charged to the next step
([`meshblock.cpp:621`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L621), `saturation_failures`).
After the step, `local_redo_flags` reads the floor test first, then the limiter marks it may have set, then drains
the saturation counter exactly once
([`meshblock.cpp:1278-1286`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1278-L1286)).
The counter read is one device-to-host copy on CUDA. A `Mesh` with several local blocks ORs their flags before the
one collective reduction
([`mesh.cpp:422-450`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/mesh.cpp#L422-L450)).

: Code map of the moist redo causes. {#tbl-ch10-redo-code}

1. Drain the counter at stage 0 ([`meshblock.cpp:621`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L621), `saturation_failures`).
2. Form the six local flags ([`meshblock.cpp:1278-1286`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1278-L1286), `local_redo_flags`).
3. Reduce with MAX over ranks and pack the bits ([`meshblock.cpp:1288-1300`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1288-L1300), `reduce_redo_flags`).
4. Name the causes in the log line ([`meshblock.cpp:1237-1240`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1237-L1240), `causes`).
5. Terminate past `max_redo` unless cause 32 ([`meshblock.cpp:1241-1247`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1241-L1247), `max_redo`).
6. Restore the saved state, recompute the primitives and the scalar ratios ([`meshblock.cpp:1249-1256`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1249-L1256), `drop_gravity_work_fix`).

The user-visible messages are the log line "Redoing the step with smaller dt (causes: ...)" and "Maximum number of redo
attempts exceeded. Terminating.", both in `apply_redo`.

### Tests

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_check_redo_saturation_python` | five arms, saturation cause alone | logical | failure protocol |
| `test_check_redo_parallel.release` | one decision on 2 ranks | exact | saved tensors copied back |
| `test_forcing.release` | species repair redoes; round-off does not | ulp bound | `kPositivityRoundoffUlp` |
| `test_uranus_cycle1_abort.release` | column survives; abort exits nonzero | exit status | log strings |

: Tests of the moist redo causes; assertions read from the test sources at the pin, not run. {#tbl-ch10-redo-tests}

`test_check_redo_saturation` starts from one NH4SH cell 150 times supersaturated. With `max-iter: 1` at least one
cell is left unadjusted, and the step must be redone with the saturation cause alone and then accepted; a control
step with the default `max-iter` must be clean; a failure counted between steps must not be charged; and a
two-block `Mesh` with the cell in block 1 must read block 1's count
([`test_check_redo_saturation.py:1-11`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/test_check_redo_saturation.py#L1-L11), `check_redo`).
The `test_forcing` cases put $-10^{-4}$ in a species at stage 1 and require cause 4; a repair below
`kPositivityRoundoffUlp` ulp of the gas density is applied but not redone
([`test_forcing.cpp:805-848`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/test_forcing.cpp#L805-L848), `limiter_species_repair_redoes_the_step`).
The CUDA arm `test_check_redo_saturation_cuda_python` exists only in CUDA builds; the 2-rank test is the only
multi-rank evidence. Measured results at the pin are **missing evidence** (@sec-ch15-ch10-tests).

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
A failure that a smaller time step cannot cure exhausts `max_redo` and ends the run (PR #248). A species repair above
round-off redoes the step even when it would be harmless.
:::

- A stale driver state can make every attempt fail ([chengcli/snapy#263](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/issues/263),
  closed as a driver defect).
- `examples/uranus.yaml` aborted at cycle 342 on an H2S repair in the issue history
  ([chengcli/snapy#260](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/issues/260)); not re-measured at the pin.
- Past `max_redo` a moist failure terminates with the rejected state in memory; only the VIC cause restores first
  (`redo_check.py` `[C3]`).
- Moist redo combinations are absent from the switch coverage matrix (@sec-ch12-matrix).
